description.excerpt: drupalSettings.path.currentQuery , set by system_js_settings_alter() , is deprecated in drupal:12.0.0 and is removed from drupal:13.0.0. It has no cache context, so query string values could leak into cached pages. Custom or contributed JavaScript that reads drupalSettings.path.currentQuery must read the current query from window.location instead. Before: const query = drupalSettings.path.currentQuery; After: const query = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);

symbols.semantics: A change record names symbols. It does not, in this contract, assert their lifecycle; that comes from the deprecation index.
